calls.title: Demo Call with Aparna Waegner from Advanced Bionics
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the complexities involved in integrating GrowthBook with their CMS, focusing on the costs and technical requirements of both server-side and client-side implementations. Server-side rendering was preferred for performance but had a high vendor estimate of 500 hours, while client-side was lower at 25-30 hours but came with its own challenges like requiring coding knowledge from authors. Chris, as the technical lead, clarified the integration architecture, including caching layers and consent management for regional compliance, while James provided insights on the visual editor's capabilities. Stakeholder roles were defined, with Chris leading technical aspects, and future steps were outlined for further demo sharing and case study creation to aid in decision-making.
calls.keywords: AEM CMS, GrowthBook, server-side rendering, client-side experimentation, visual editor, vendor estimation
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Send Chris a video demo of GrowthBook’s visual editor for internal sharing to help evaluate its capabilities for non-technical authors (26:17)
Investigate and share any available AEM integration examples or level of effort (LOE) estimates to support Chris’s vendor discussions regarding server-side GrowthBook implementation (26:17)
Offer access to GrowthBook’s internal architecture team for deeper technical consultations to clarify implementation complexity and reduce uncertainty (18:48)

**Chris Martyniuk**
Review and present the visual editor video demo internally to evaluate its suitability for authoring branded experiences without coding (26:40)
Share or discuss the architectural diagram and server-side integration approach internally and with the vendor, incorporating insights from GrowthBook information and demo (14:00)
